reviews.feedback: 1. internal/store/customers.go: customersByEmail is keyed by normalized email only, but the uniqueness rule is per organization. CreateCustomers (line 44-45, 60) and CustomerEmailsTaken (line 72) therefore miss an address that an existing customer of the importing org holds when another org has since registered the same address (CreateCustomer at line 22-27 allows that, and overwrites the map entry). Result: the import creates a duplicate email in the org instead of returning email_taken. Fix: key the email index by org and normalized email (e.g. orgID+"\x00"+normEmail(email)) and update every use (CreateCustomer, CreateCustomers, CustomerEmailsTaken, FindCustomerByEmail, UpdateCustomer, DeleteCustomer). Add a test: org A has jane@x, org B creates jane@x, then org A's import of jane@x must return 422 email_taken and create nothing. 2. Optional: in internal/api/customers.go row(), two metadata columns with the same key are filled in random map-iteration order; make the choice deterministic.
